July 29: The Queen of Hearts ♥

People born on July 29 have the Queen of Hearts as their cardology birth card, with the King of Hearts as their planetary ruling card.

Karma cards for the Queen of Hearts

  • Running under: You're emotionally hypervigilant from childhood trauma, reading the room while sacrificing your own needs.
  • Running over: You're the emotional tyrant, smothering with control while building guilt-debt systems masked as love.
